bookclub_description:
The JuiceSSH Tech Library is a community curated list of technical books that other JuiceSSH users have found helpful and relevant. All books purchased help support the ongoing development of JuiceSSH. We make a small amount of money for each purchase made.

If you've read a good technical book recently, use the button below to recommend it to the JuiceSSH community.

cloudsync_long_description:
CloudSync securely backs up and synchronises your connections and settings between all of your devices.

CloudSync is backed by strong AES-256 encryption to protect all of your information. The result is that any synchronised information can only be decrypted with the passphrase you've set.

Neither JuiceSSH CloudSync servers, Google or any other potential attacker will ever have the ability to eavesdrop or decrypt your information.
cloudsync_passphrase_required:
In order to encrypt your information during the synchronisation process an encryption passphrase is required.

You must use the same passphrase on all of your devices in order for CloudSync to function.

8 or 16 is usually a good starting point.
